solution:
Correct option: (b) To get the right price for agricultural product.

The chapter lists the demands of the farmers movement and puts this one first: ‘Appropriate price for agricultural products, agriculture to be treated as an industry, implementation of the recommendations of the Swaminathan Commission, debt relief, debt cancellation, national policy for agriculture are some of the demands of the farmers movement.’

The forest-land option is the main demand of a different movement — the chapter says the main demand of the TRIBAL movement is that their right over forests be accepted, including the right to cultivate on forest land — and protection of consumers belongs to the consumer movement.

solution:
Correct option: (b) Green revolution.

The chapter says the Green Revolution ‘aimed at increasing agricultural production and achieving self-sufficiency in food grains’. It adds that it did not benefit the poor farmers, which divided farmers into rich and poor and led to the later farmers movement.
